name: energoska-taste
product: Энергоська: PWA для пары (iOS Safari), энергетики, оценки, цены, вода
invariants: max_energy_cans_per_day=2; third only via 3s hold, flagged over_limit; no UI for 3+
only is_energy drinks count toward limit, stats, ratings, main button
dark-first; light via prefers-color-scheme; one token set; no brand accent color; color only from cans and players
fonts: Unbounded (text), Oswald (numbers); inputs >=16px system font
single radius 12 (circles full); no blur shadows; backgrounds: circles only; Depth bg + weak PNG grain
animate only transform/opacity (exception: hold ring stroke-dashoffset)
countries BY/RU: prices and shops not compared across countries
every input has a with-keyboard state; every screen checked in dark and light and in states empty/loading/error/offline/photo-pending/limit
change only what is asked; frozen decisions per docs/06-decisions.md

shell and keyboard are FROZEN (verified on real iPhone 2026-10-02): html/body 100% height, #app height in px from src/viewport.js, tab bar position:absolute over the list; no position:fixed body, no 100dvh root, no interactive-widget; see docs/07-app-shell.md
